preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have a length equal to n and consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and any(s[l-1] > s[r-1] for l in range(1, n) for r in range(l+1, n+1)))
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to reverse a substring to obtain a lexicographically smaller string, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by valid indices l and r.
